title: General Core Utilities
summary: This module provides a collection of fundamental utility functions and classes, including tools for managing data streams, parsing HTML, handling Pydantic models, validating arguments, reporting system information, and in-memory caching. It offers essential building blocks for various framework operations.

nodes.label: Split Async Iterator
nodes.title: Asynchronous Iterator Tee
nodes.description: Provides a mechanism to create multiple independent asynchronous iterators from a single source. It buffers items, ensuring all child iterators receive the same sequence of elements, suitable for concurrent processing of a single data stream.

nodes.label: Extract & Filter HTML Links
nodes.title: HTML Link Extractor
nodes.description: Parses HTML content to extract and normalize embedded links, converting them to absolute URLs. It includes filtering capabilities to restrict links to a base URL or exclude specific prefixes, useful for web content analysis.

nodes.label: Split Synchronous Iterator
nodes.title: Synchronous Iterator Tee
nodes.description: Generates multiple independent synchronous iterators from a single iterable source. It buffers elements to ensure consistent data delivery across all child iterators, enabling parallel or sequential processing of a single data stream.

nodes.label: Pydantic Model Init Wrapper
nodes.title: Pydantic Init Wrapper
nodes.description: A decorator that enhances Pydantic model initialization by handling default field values and enabling population of fields using their alias names, streamlining model creation.

nodes.label: Get Pydantic Version
nodes.title: Pydantic Version Getter
nodes.description: Retrieves the major version number of the installed Pydantic library, primarily for compatibility checks. Note: This function is deprecated.

nodes.label: Argument Validation Decorator
nodes.title: Exclusive Argument Validator
nodes.description: A decorator that enforces a constraint where exactly one argument within specified groups must be provided (non-None) to a function, ensuring valid parameter combinations.

nodes.label: Print System Information
nodes.title: System Information Reporter
nodes.description: Collects and displays comprehensive system and package details, including OS, Python version, and installed LangChain libraries, for debugging and environment assessment.

nodes.label: In-Memory LLM Cache
nodes.title: LLM Response Cache
nodes.description: An efficient in-memory cache for storing and retrieving Language Model (LLM) responses. It supports both synchronous and asynchronous operations and can be configured with a maximum size to manage memory usage.

groups.label: Surface Utilities
groups.title: General Purpose Utilities
groups.description: Contains decorators and helper functions for common programming patterns and environment checks.

groups.label: Analytical Tools
groups.title: Analysis and Reporting
groups.description: Provides tools for analyzing content (like HTML) and reporting on the system environment.

groups.label: Data Stream Management
groups.title: Iterator Management
groups.description: Components designed for splitting and managing both synchronous and asynchronous data streams.

groups.label: Data Storage
groups.title: Caching Mechanisms
groups.description: Includes an in-memory caching solution for efficient storage and retrieval of LLM responses.
